title: ExperimentSpec
description: The 'run one trial' contract. A complete, bounded, reproducible instruction to the host: change exactly these parameters from defaults, run once, report honestly. Laws: 1 (host measures), 2 (bounded), 3 (identity for lineage).

experiment_id.description: Globally unique experiment identity. The unit of work (principle 8.4). Issued by KAV.

project_id.description: Must match manifest and search space.

hypothesis_id.description: The single hypothesis this experiment tests. Exactly one per experiment (ADR-002).

parameter.description: Must exist in SearchSpace and be mutable.

value.description: Must lie within the parameter's declared domain.

changes.description: Deltas from defaults. Every entry must validate against the SearchSpace — KAV validates before issuing.

budget.description: This experiment's limits; must each be <= manifest limits. Law 2.

dataset_ref.description: Dataset identity reference, if the host versions data.
